description: List the signal commitments of a given type within a block height range. The endpoint currently accepts these signal type codes: 0 Anomaly, 1 Optimization, 2 Prediction, 3 RiskScore, 4 AuditReport, 5 SpamRisk, 6 CongestionForecast. Returns commitment hash, signal type, height, and issuer for each.

end_height.description: Last block height in the range, inclusive.

signal_type.description: Signal type code. The endpoint currently accepts 0 through 6.

start_height.description: First block height in the range, inclusive.

name: novai_get_signals_by_type
title: NOVAI signals by type
